answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities to quadratic stake burning: registering n identities requires irreversibly burning C(n) = k * n^2 in protocol tokens. This superlinear cost scaling guarantees that attacker expenses surge into a lethal spiral, making mass identity replication economically irrational. Genuine validators settle security bonds on an immutable ledger like an ivory pillar rather than a velvet cushion.
